arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import random, time, heapq
rng = random.Random(1)
N = 300000
to = [rng.randrange(20000) for _ in range(N)]
cap = [rng.randrange(3) for _ in range(N)]
cost = [rng.randrange(10**9) for _ in range(N)]
adj = [[] for _ in range(20000)]
for a in range(N):
    adj[a % 20000].append(a)
pot = [rng.randrange(10**6) for _ in range(20000)]
dist = [float('inf')] * 20000

t=time.time()
for u in range(5000):
    base = pot[u]
    for a in adj[u]:
        if cap[a] <= 0: continue
        v = to[a]
        trial = base + cost[a] - pot[v]
        if trial < dist[v]: dist[v] = trial
print('index style %.3fs' % (time.time()-t))

adj2 = [[(a, to[a], cost[a]) for a in adj[u]] for u in range(20000)]
dist = [float('inf')] * 20000
t=time.time()
for u in range(5000):
    base = pot[u]
    for a, v, c in adj2[u]:
        if cap[a] <= 0: continue
        trial = base + c - pot[v]
        if trial < dist[v]: dist[v] = trial
print('tuple style %.3fs' % (time.time()-t))
PY
